items.title: Overlapping reviews counted as independent evidence
items.whyItMatters: Primary studies overlap across reviews (claim c3); counting reviews inflates confidence.
items.opportunity: Build a citation matrix and report the corrected covered area; prefer the most recent high-quality review per question.

items.title: Patient outcomes barely measured
items.whyItMatters: Only two trials measured pain and function (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Report patient outcomes separately and say plainly how little is known.

items.title: Equity effects unknown
items.whyItMatters: Few studies report subgroup effects and none by language.
items.opportunity: Extract any subgroup results and recommend equity monitoring in the specification.

items.title: An untraceable 40 percent figure
items.whyItMatters: The figure colleagues cite matches no retrieved record; the model's landmark lead is unverified.
items.opportunity: Do not cite the figure; attempt to retrieve and check the lead by its identifier.

errorsFound: The discovery reply presented an unretrieved multicentre study as a landmark with a DOI; it remains an unverified lead.
reevaluation: An umbrella review with AMSTAR 2 appraisal and overlap handling is the right design; primary studies should be revisited only where reviews conflict.
summary: Four gaps: overlap, patient outcomes, equity and an untraceable figure.
